newsitem.title: UK: UK business failures down 0.5 pct in 1996 -D&B.
newsitem.headline: UK business failures down 0.5 pct in 1996 -D&B.

text.p: Business information suppliers Dun & Bradstreet released the following data on business failures in Britain in 1996:
NOTE - The percentage fall compares with post-recession drops of 11.2 percent in 1992 and 21.9 percent in 1994.
Small businesses did better than large companies. There was a 5.5 precent decrease in small business bankruptcies compared with a 6.5 percent increase in company liquidations.

Philip Mellor, senior analyst at D&B, said the figures were disappointing. "These are disappointing figures for the New Year, particularly in view of an end-of-the-year increase in company liquidations."
He said cash flow pressures on larger businesses were tending to increase and could affect small companies in 1997.
